## Problem / user story

What task is difficult today? Describe a real workflow, not just a settings label.

## Proposed behavior

What should happen on tap, swipe, long-press, rotation or restore?

## Examples and evidence

If comparing another launcher, provide app version, Android version, screenshots and public links. Separate verified behavior from memory/hypothesis.

## Privacy, permissions, accessibility

Does this need sensitive permissions, network, widgets or profiles? How should it work with TalkBack and reduced motion?

## Priority / alternatives

Is there a workaround? What would you give up to get this feature?
